_meta.description: Phase 4d (s185, 2026-05-13) - per-champion max_priority overrides for the ds.ability (mage) and ds.burst (assassin) scorers. Without an override, both scorers use the canonical Q-first / W-second / E-third order from agents/daemon_slayer/ability_dps.py:rank_at_level - fine for most champions (Veigar, Lux, Annie, Syndra, Zoe, etc.) but wrong for champions whose primary damage spell is W or E. Keys are DDragon canonical champion ids (NOT display names - display→id resolution happens server-side in _resolve_champion_id). Values are 3-key permutations of (Q, W, E). Phase 5.9.27 (s227, 2026-05-16): max_priority coverage audit. `tools/ds_max_priority_prefilter.py` A/B'd all 6 (Q,W,E) orderings vs the default for every champion → it flagged ~59, but the numeric level-11 optimum is NOT the real in-game max order for most (it flags Azir W-first, contradicting universal Q-max; Ziggs/Ryze/Taliyah numerically reorder but really max Q which the default already does). max_priority is a play-pattern registry, NOT a numeric-sweepable pure-data batch - do not auto-expand it from the pre-filter. After filtering to ds.ability/ds.burst-archetype champions AND cross-checking against established meta, only 3 had a universally-known non-default order the registry genuinely missed: Brand W-E-Q (Pillar of Flame is Brand's primary damage+waveclear - maxed W-first for years; the original s185 _meta wrongly listed Brand as a 'default is fine' example - corrected here), Talon W-Q-E (Rake is Talon's canonical max-first), Fiddlesticks W-E-Q (Bountiful Harvest drain is the standard jungle max). Live A/B (lvl 11): Brand +18.7%, Fiddlesticks +16.4%, Talon +12.0% total ability_dps. The sibling combo_sequence registry was assessed in the same iteration and found ADEQUATE for its stated purpose (reset/shadow/chain casts - Zed Q2 / Yone Q3 / Akali R2 / Kata W-dagger): the assassin-archetype champs genuinely NOT in it (Shaco/Ekko - Fizz/Katarina ARE curated) have no reset/shadow/chain mechanic the default Q-W-E-AA-R-AA misses, so no clean additions - a valid negative result.
_meta.rationale: max_priority controls which ability is ranked highest at any given level, which directly affects per-cast damage contribution. Cassiopeia's E (Twin Fang, cd 0.75s) is her primary DPS spell; with the default Q-first table the scorer treats her Twin Fang as rank-1 until level 14, dramatically under-counting AP scaling. Same shape for Kayle E (Starfire Spellblade on-hit), Akali E (Shuriken Flip AP burst), Heimerdinger W (Hextech Micro-Rockets - Q is turret deploy with no direct damage at all), Twisted Fate W (Pick a Card), Leblanc W (Distortion), Kassadin E (Force Pulse), Rumble E (Electro Harpoon, cd 0.5s spam), Anivia E (Frostbite proc), and Lillia W (Watch Out! Eep! AoE). s227: Brand W (Pillar of Flame, his highest base + AoE waveclear - W-E-Q is THE Brand order), Talon W (Rake, his waveclear+poke - W-Q-E with E often a single utility point), Fiddlesticks W (Bountiful Harvest, the channeled drain that defines his jungle clear+damage - W-E-Q). Each verified both against established meta AND the s227 pre-filter's per-rank A/B (rank shifts: default leaves W at rank 2 / their key spell under-ranked; W-first lifts it to rank 4 → +12-19% total ability_dps).
